If all you're doing is gaming, the upgrade isn't worth it, unless you're still on like a 9 or 10 series, which I know a good amount of people still are. I had a work PC before leaving my day job that had a 2080TI and that definitely would still hold up on current gen games. 

With a 3080, In CP2077 I was getting a solid 60fps at almost maxed out, with the 5070TI I got to 80-100fps at completely maxed out but as a single player, cinematic style game, those extra 20-40 frames aren't worth $1000.
